title: Zoning text change for 1455 Coney Island Avenue, Brooklyn
summary: This application would establish a Mandatory Inclusionary Housing area at 1455 Coney Island Avenue in Midwood, Brooklyn, alongside a related zoning map change. Together the actions would enable a nine-story, about 157,000-square-foot long-term care facility with roughly 300 beds, office space, a café and a house of worship. The City Planning Commission approved the application on September 9, 2026.
